## Predictions

- Windows tried: 30 days, 60 days, 90 days; each must pass the gate at 96.7% confidence, corrected for trying 3.
- A model to predict whether collision happens within 30 days was promoted. On 8,216 held-out entities the model ranks outcomes with AUC 0.971, against 0.894 for the baseline rule. At 97% confidence the gain is between +0.069 and +0.087 (AUC). It was also checked in 3 segments (history length) and is not clearly worse than the baseline rule in any of them. None of the 12 candidate inputs the search tried improved it.
- A model to predict whether collision happens within 60 days was promoted. On 7,762 held-out entities the model ranks outcomes with AUC 0.958, against 0.859 for the baseline rule. None of the 12 candidate inputs the search tried improved it.
- A model to predict whether collision happens within 90 days was promoted. On 7,289 held-out entities the model ranks outcomes with AUC 0.950, against 0.840 for the baseline rule. At 97% confidence the gain is between +0.100 and +0.117 (AUC). It was also checked in 3 segments (history length) and is not clearly worse than the baseline rule in any of them. - A model to predict the value of the next collision was promoted. On 540 held-out entities its average error is 0.44, against 0.48 for the baseline rule.
